verses.text: “So remember Me; I will remember you.”

end.gold: Tonight, before you sleep: nine Alhamdulillahs. One for each complaint.

captions: Friday, 6:10 p.m. Five-a-side, cold rain, floodlights on.
The traffic. The boss. The cold. The ref. Your knee.
Number nine: “Why does this always happen to me?”
You slip. You sit on the wet grass, out of breath.
Two legs that ran all evening. Lungs that never asked.
Eyes that saw every goal. And not one word of thanks.
On the way to Isha, still limping, you start counting.
Alhamdulillah for the legs. For the rain. For the breath.
Nine times. The knee still hurts. The heart doesn't.

post.caption:
9 complaints today. Not one Alhamdulillah. 🌙

The traffic. The boss. The cold. The ref. Your knee. Then you slip and sit on the wet grass, out of breath — two legs that ran all evening, lungs that never asked, eyes that saw every goal. And not one word of thanks.

“So remember Me; I will remember you.” (2:152)

Tonight, before you sleep: nine Alhamdulillahs. One for each complaint.
